# Laurel Pass Partners

> Laurel Pass Partners acquires established DWI and criminal-defense law practices in the New York City area from owners ready to step back.

Laurel Pass Partners is an attorney-led firm that buys and runs established DWI, criminal-defense and other flat-fee practices in New York City, Long Island and Westchester. Practices stay lawyer-owned, staff and client relationships carry over, and every conversation is confidential. Most of the price is paid at closing. Laurel Pass Partners is not affiliated with any other firm using the Laurel name. Contact: spencer@laurelpasspartners.com

## Start here

- [Laurel Pass Partners](https://laurelpasspartners.com/): Who we are, what we look for (DWI/DUI defense first, other flat-fee practices welcome; $500K–$5M in annual fees; New York City, Long Island and Westchester) and how to start a confidential conversation.

## Guides for practice owners

- [How a Law Practice Sale Works in New York](https://laurelpasspartners.com/how-a-sale-works): How selling your New York law practice to Laurel Pass Partners works: the confidential first call, what we review, the letter of intent, client notices and closing.
- [Selling a DWI Practice in New York: A Guide for Owners](https://laurelpasspartners.com/selling-a-dwi-practice-in-new-york): How to sell a DWI defense practice in New York under Rule 1.17: client notice, open matters and prepaid fees, staff, timeline and choosing the right buyer.
- [What Is My Law Practice Worth? Valuing a Flat-Fee Practice](https://laurelpasspartners.com/what-is-my-practice-worth): What drives the value of a DWI or other flat-fee law practice, how buyers measure earnings, how payment terms change the price, and what to gather first.
- [How Is the Sale of a Law Practice Taxed?](https://laurelpasspartners.com/how-the-sale-is-taxed): Questions for your accountant before you sell a law practice: price allocation and Form 8594, personal goodwill, seller notes, earnouts and transition pay.
- [Private Equity or a Lawyer? Your Options for Selling a New York Law Practice](https://laurelpasspartners.com/your-options): Attorney buyer, merger, broker, private equity through an MSO, or winding down: how each option works for a New York law practice owner.

## About and contact

- [Questions About Selling Your Law Practice](https://laurelpasspartners.com/faq): Answers to the questions New York practice owners ask Laurel Pass Partners: who we are, what we buy, price and timing, clients, staff, confidentiality and taxes.
- [About Laurel Pass Partners](https://laurelpasspartners.com/about): Laurel Pass Partners is led by a New York attorney with a background in large-firm M&A and tax. What we do, how we work and what we believe about practice sales.
- [Law Practice Buyer in New York: For Brokers, CPAs and Advisors](https://laurelpasspartners.com/referral-partners): What Laurel Pass Partners buys, what we need for a first look, and how we treat the practice owners that brokers, CPAs and bar succession advisors introduce.
- [Guides and Insights for Law Practice Owners](https://laurelpasspartners.com/insights): Plain-English guides and dated articles for New York lawyers thinking about selling a practice: the sale process, valuation, taxes, client notice and succession.

## Articles

- [What Happens to Your Clients When You Sell a New York Practice](https://laurelpasspartners.com/insights/what-happens-to-your-clients-when-you-sell): Under New York Rule 1.17, clients get a joint written notice, can choose other counsel, and keep their fee agreements. How that works in practice.
- [Can Your Firm Name Stay on the Door After You Sell?](https://laurelpasspartners.com/insights/can-your-firm-name-stay-on-the-door): What New York allows when a buyer wants to keep a selling lawyer's firm name, and how to plan a name change.
